posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif's pregnancy is the talk of B-town as fans spot her baby bump in viral shoot photos; she and Vicky Kaushal are set to welcome their first child.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh is having a landmark week — the LA City Council declared a 'Diljit Dosanjh Day' on his 43rd birthday, honouring his role in taking Punjabi music global as his Aura World Tour rolls through the US.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt is in full promo mode for 'Alpha', the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film out July 3; her fearless, fun turn alongside Sharvari on India's Got Latent has gone viral.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra is gearing up for her big Indian return as Mandakini in SS Rajamouli's globe-trotting epic 'Varanasi', and just teased an exciting new collaboration with Angelina Jolie.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK has the internet buzzing over 'King', locked for Christmas 2026 — the high-octane actioner marks daughter Suhana Khan's big-screen debut opposite him.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan's gritty Meghna Gulzar thriller 'Daayra' with Prithviraj Sukumaran has locked a September 18 release, and reports say she's set to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor is winning fans in a never-before-seen avatar as the buzz around her teaser 'Eetha' builds online.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone is balancing new motherhood with a packed slate — she rejoins Shah Rukh Khan for 'King' and is set to become the first Indian with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh is on a victory lap as 'Dhurandhar' continues its blockbuster run, with peers from Allu Arjun to Jr NTR showering praise on his fearless performance.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan won hearts at Cannes by recreating her iconic ivory Banarasi saree look 23 years on, pairing it with a bold sindoor statement that went viral.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna is celebrating 'Cocktail 2', which scored a strong Rs 13.10 crore opening — her sixth-biggest debut ever — as she shuts down rivalry rumours with co-star Kriti Sanon.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is glowing as fans spot a baby bump at her 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' success bash; reports say she and director-husband Raj Nidimoru are expecting their first child.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is the centre of Tollywood buzz after amicably parting ways with director Trivikram over scheduling, as fans pin hopes on his VFX-heavy Atlee sci-fi 'Raaka'.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' is firmly in the spotlight, with anticipation soaring and a future film with Trivikram on the cards.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR is dominating headlines on two fronts — gearing up for the June 26 box-office clash of Prashanth Neel's 'Dragon', and a confirmed four-film lineup including a 'God of War' film with Trivikram.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor is spreading the love, cheering on Alia Bhatt and Sharvari as 'two badass women' for the 'Alpha' trailer while she preps her own big projects.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday is turning heads in a viral fashion feature, acing the corset look alongside Alia Bhatt, Kareena Kapoor, Janhvi Kapoor and Kiara Advani.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani is back in the style spotlight, nailing the corset trend in a buzzy group fashion feature with Bollywood's leading ladies.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan continues to bask in the YRF Spy Universe glow after 'War 2' with Jr NTR, with fans eagerly awaiting his next as Kabir and updates on 'Krrish 4'.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan is gearing up for the patriotic multi-starrer 'Border 2', one of his most anticipated films, even as his recent music collaborations keep trending.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal marked World Music Day in style as her global 'The Unstoppable Tour' gears up for a major North American leg this September, spanning Boston to LA.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is having a milestone moment — he unveiled the soundtrack for 'Baab', his first-ever Arabic film, and released a teaser of Asha Bhosle's reportedly final studio recording on World Music Day.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay is riding a historic high after his party TVK swept 108 seats in his blockbuster political debut, supercharging anticipation for his final film 'Jana Nayagan', which has crossed Rs 325 crore in pre-business.
